title: Query (Index) Lifecycle State + Transition
description: Query-snapshot lifecycle. Only ACTIVE snapshots answer normal user queries; INDEX_FAILED never becomes ACTIVE and never disturbs the current ACTIVE snapshot.
x-invariants: Activation is atomic: exactly one ACTIVE snapshot at a time; promoting a new ACTIVE and demoting the old is a single transaction.
INDEX_FAILED is terminal for that build and triggers rollback_target; the prior ACTIVE snapshot is untouched.
